notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no WAF/challenge (tier 1 only). The site's single unified /collections/new-arrivals page EXISTS but is genuinely empty ('No products in this collection yet', 0 Products) - dropped per the zero-product rule, noted here instead. New Arrivals is instead expressed sitewide as ~40 real per-category children under two naming families: '<category>-new-arrival(s)' and 'whats-new-<category>'. Discovery: grepped both collections sitemaps (sitemap_collections_1.xml + _2.xml, 3226 URLs) for these patterns, then opened every candidate. Confirmed these are genuine, clickable site navigation (not orphan SEO pages) - e.g. /collections/clocks has a 'plp-sub-nav' tile literally labelled 'New Arrivals' linking to new-arrivals-clocks, /collections/wall-decor has one labelled 'New Arrival' linking to wall-decor-new-arrival, /collections/pots-planters has one labelled "What's New" linking to whats-new-pots-planters, etc. Every one of the 40 rows below was individually verified: real 'N Products' summary-count element present, and an exhaustion check (ceil(qty/20) compared against the page's actual last ?page=N link) matched exactly for all 40 - no estimates. Since there is no single unified parent New Arrivals page with real product content (the literal /new-arrivals page is empty) and each child tile lives inside its own unrelated category's subnav rather than under one common New-Arrivals umbrella, none are emitted as is_group parents - all 40 are standalone rows per the is_group rule, consistent with the site's own flat per-category presentation. 'New Arrival Home Decor' (new-arrival-home-decor, 6880 products) is its own distinct department-level listing with no subnav children of its own and a product count far smaller than the sum of the granular per-subcategory rows below, confirming it is a genuinely separate listing, not an alias/union of the others - kept as its own row per the 'different product sets -> keep both' rule. Checked and ruled out as non-PLP duplicates/aliases: none found (all 40 slugs resolved to distinct non-empty listings). Site is India/English-only; no local-language nav variant exists.
